title: Larkspur Health: loop in legal
transcript:
[00:00] Owen: Larkspur Health. They're ready to sign, pending their privacy review.
[00:07] Chiara: Their privacy officer sent our data processing agreement back with comments. Mostly about subprocessors.
[00:17] Bashir: We added two subprocessors last quarter, so the list in the DPA is out of date.
[00:25] Owen: Can we just update the list?
[00:28] Chiara: We can. But they also want breach notice within 48 hours instead of 72. That's a legal call, not ours.
[00:40] Owen: OK. Chiara, can you loop in legal before Friday?
[00:45] Chiara: Yep, I'll loop in legal today.
[00:49] Bashir: I'll send you the updated subprocessor list so it all goes over together.
[00:56] Chiara: Thanks, that saves a round trip.
[01:00] Owen: What's the timeline on their side?
[01:04] Chiara: Their board signs off on new vendors on the 6th.
[01:09] Owen: Fine. If legal is OK with 48 hours, we're done.
[01:14] Bashir: And if they're not?
[01:17] Owen: Then I'll call their privacy officer myself and find a middle ground.
[01:24] Chiara: Makes sense.
[01:26] Bashir: Should I also update the public subprocessor page?
[01:31] Owen: Yes, same day as the DPA list, so they match.
[01:36] Bashir: Will do.
[01:38] Owen: Great. Thanks, everyone.
